files.root.ubnf: grammar G { @import a from 'child.ubnf' @import a from 'child.ubnf' @ubnf: v2 }

files.child.ubnf: grammar C { @import a from 'root.ubnf' @ubnf: v2 token T ::= 'a'; }

files.root.ubnf: grammar G { @import a from 'child.ubnf' @ubnf: v2 token T ::= a.MISSING; }

files.child.ubnf: grammar A { @ubnf: v2 token T ::= 'a'; } grammar B { @ubnf: v2 token T ::= 'b'; }

files.root.ubnf: grammar G { @import a from 'child.ubnf' @ubnf: v2 token DIGIT ::= '0'; token T ::= a.NUMBER; }
files.child.ubnf: grammar C { @ubnf: v2 token NUMBER ::= DIGIT+; }

files.root.ubnf: grammar G { @import a from 'child.ubnf' @ubnf: v2 token T ::= a.T SAME_AS(x); @root @mapping(V,params=[v]) R ::= T @v; }
files.child.ubnf: grammar C { @ubnf: v2 token T ::= CAPTURE(x,'a'); }
